description: This file defines the 'pdcp_entity_rx' class for receiving PDCP bearers, including state management, PDU handling, security, reordering, and related structures and methods within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_rx
classes.description: Final class for receiving PDCP bearers, managing PDU processing, security, reordering, and state.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_rx::reordering_callback
classes.description: Callback class for handling t-Reordering timer expiration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops handling PDUs and stops timers.

methods.name: get_count
methods.description: Retrieves current RX count info for status transfer.

methods.name: set_count
methods.description: Sets RX count info for status transfer.

methods.name: crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns an event flag to wait for crypto tasks to finish.

methods.name: notify_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notifies that PDU processing has stopped.

methods.name: compile_status_report
methods.description: Compiles a PDCP status report control PDU.

methods.name: read_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Reads and parses the header of a data PDU.

methods.name: configure_security
methods.description: Configures security parameters for the entity.

methods.name: is_reordering_timer_running
methods.description: Checks if reordering timer is active.

methods.name: nof_pdus_in_window
methods.description: Returns number of PDUs in the RX window.

methods.name: apply_security
methods.description: Applies security (deciphering and integrity check) to PDU.

methods.name: deliver_sdu
methods.description: Delivers an SDU to upper layers.

methods.name: deliver_all_sdus
methods.description: Delivers all SDUs in the window.

methods.name: init_header_decompression
methods.description: Initializes header decompression if ROHC is configured.

methods.name: log_state
methods.description: Logs current state at specified log level.
